engine.prompt: Steady continuous hum and whine of twin turbofan jet engines heard from inside an airliner cockpit, constant pitch, no voices, no music

wind.prompt: Steady continuous airflow wind noise around an airliner cockpit in flight, constant hiss, no voices

tower_room.prompt: Quiet air traffic control tower room tone: soft ventilation and faint electronic equipment hum, no voices

gear.prompt: Aircraft landing gear extending: hydraulic whine, then a heavy mechanical clunk as it locks

flaps.prompt: Electric motor whirring as aircraft wing flaps move, short, mechanical

speedbrake.prompt: Short hydraulic actuator whine as airliner wing spoiler panels move, followed by a brief rush of buffeting air, heard from the cabin, no voices

touchdown.prompt: Airliner main wheels touching down on a runway: brief tyre screech and a low thump with rumble

crash.prompt: Heavy aircraft crash impact: metal crunching and debris, short

splash.prompt: Very large object hitting water at speed: huge splash

warning.prompt: Aircraft cockpit master warning: urgent repetitive electronic chime, three beeps

radio.prompt: Short burst of aviation radio static and a click as a transmission starts
